caseName: Gomez-Hermanos, Inc. v. Secretary of the Treasury of Puerto Rico
caseNameFull: Gomez-Hermanos, Inc. v. Secretary of the Treasury of Puerto Rico
judges: Blackmun, Consideration, Hearing, Merits, Postpone, Question, White

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. P. R. dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Reported below:-P. R. R.-.

Justice White, Justice Blackmun, and Justice Rehnquist would postpone further consideration of the question of jurisdiction until a hearing of the case on the merits.
